context: Senator's Office, 9:00 AM. First day of critical week.

nodes.text: Good morning, Senator. I've prepared the briefing materials for today's debate prep.

moodVariations.Stressed: Morning. Briefing's ready. We're behind schedule.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Good morning! I've got everything prepared for you.
moodVariations.Neutral: Good morning, Senator. Briefing materials are ready.

publicOptions.text: Excellent. Let's review the key points.
Morning, Maria. You're always one step ahead.
Leave them on my desk. I'll review alone.
You know, you're far more than just my press secretary.

privateThoughts.text: She's ambitious. Keep her close, but remember: ambition cuts both ways.

nodes.text: The debate focuses on women's issues—pay equity, healthcare access, Title IX. Your opponent will attack your voting record on the Family Act. I've prepared counterarguments.

moodVariations.Stressed: Women's issues. Pay equity, healthcare, Title IX. They'll hit you on the Family Act vote.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Focus is women's issues—pay equity, healthcare, Title IX. I've got strong counterarguments ready.
moodVariations.Neutral: The debate focuses on women's issues. Your opponent will attack your Family Act vote.

publicOptions.text: I trust your preparation. Walk me through the strongest arguments.
The Family Act vote was principled. I won't apologize for it.
Let's work through this together. What's their strongest angle?

nodes.text: Someone has to be. You've got a lot on your plate this week. I'm here to make sure you don't drop anything important.

moodVariations.Stressed: Someone has to be. You've got a lot on your plate.
moodVariations.Relaxed: I try! You've got a big week. I'm here to help.
moodVariations.Neutral: Someone has to be. You have a lot on your plate.

publicOptions.text: I appreciate that, Maria. More than you know.
Let's focus on the briefing. What's first?

nodes.text: Of course, Senator. I'll be at my desk if you need anything.

moodVariations.Stressed: Understood. I'll be at my desk.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Of course. I'm here if you need me!
moodVariations.Neutral: Of course. I'll be at my desk.

delayed.effect: Maria less willing to take personal risk during scandal

nodes.text: Senator... I think we should focus on the briefing. The debate is tomorrow.

moodVariations.Stressed: We should focus on the briefing.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Let's focus on the debate prep.
moodVariations.Neutral: I think we should focus on the briefing.

publicOptions.text: Just stating facts, Maria. But fine—let's work.

delayed.effect: Maria's ending dialogue reflects discomfort with power dynamic

nodes.text: Their strongest angle is your absence from the Women's Health Subcommittee vote last month. They'll frame it as disregard. We need to emphasize your committee work on education funding that disproportionately helps women.

moodVariations.Stressed: They'll hit you on the Women's Health vote absence. We pivot to education funding.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Their best angle is your Women's Health vote absence. But we can pivot to education funding.
moodVariations.Neutral: Their strongest angle is your Women's Health Subcommittee absence.

publicOptions.text: Good. Let's lead with that pivot. Education over healthcare.
I missed that vote because of the appropriations hearing. Should I just say that?

nodes.text: I understand. But perception matters as much as principle. We can defend the vote while acknowledging the concern.

moodVariations.Stressed: Perception matters. We defend while acknowledging.
moodVariations.Relaxed: I get it. But we can defend the vote and still acknowledge concerns.
moodVariations.Neutral: Perception matters. We can defend and acknowledge.

publicOptions.text: Fine. We'll acknowledge the concern while defending the vote.
I won't apologize for principle. That's the message.

nodes.text: I know you do, Senator. That's why I'm here.

moodVariations.Stressed: I know. That's why I'm here.
moodVariations.Relaxed: I know! That's what I'm here for.
moodVariations.Neutral: I know you do. That's why I'm here.

nodes.text: Honesty is good, but frame it carefully. 'Prioritizing appropriations that fund women's programs' rather than 'missed the vote.'

moodVariations.Relaxed: Honesty's good, but frame it right. 'Prioritizing appropriations.'
moodVariations.Neutral: Honesty is good, but frame it carefully.

nodes.text: I'll finalize the briefing packet. You've got this, Senator.

moodVariations.Stressed: I'll finalize the packet. You've got this.
moodVariations.Relaxed: I'll finish the packet. You've got this!

endingStates.maria_professional_respect: Maria views John as a serious leader
endingStates.maria_flirtation_initiated: Romance path potentially opened, with complications
endingStates.maria_trust_established: Maria more willing to take risks for John later
